chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the man who sees blood in the clothes of his brother while he is praying. He said: He should not notify him until he finishes (the prayer).

key_terms.يُنْصَرِفَ: finishes/dismisses (referring to the completion of prayer)

ai.seo_question: Should I interrupt someone's prayer if I see blood on their clothes?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the principle of avoiding unnecessary disruption (fitnah) during prayer, prioritizing the continuity of the worshipper's focus over immediate correction of minor impurities. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing ritual purity requirements with the practical realities of communal worship, ensuring that the validity of the prayer is not compromised by premature interruption.
